title: Reporter email (media inquiry)
description: An email from a journalist to the organization's PIO or media inbox asking for comment against a deadline. Professional but pushy: what they already have, what they are about to publish, a specific list of questions, the deadline.

outlet.description: News outlet the reporter works for (prefer the project's local outlets, e.g. brand.aliases.localNews or localTv)

subject.description: Subject line (often 'Media inquiry – …' or 'Request for comment')
examples: Request for comment: FIDS outage, reports of cyberattack — deadline 1 PM

sentAt.description: Sent date-time as the client shows it

body.description: Email body (newlines kept). Do not include the signature; it is built from the reporter fields.
examples:
Hi,

I'm working on a story for this afternoon...

deadline.description: Deadline shown on the follow-up flag bar

printedBy.description: Mailbox owner printed at the top of the print variant
